title: Dialogue Definition
description: Semantic source of truth for one NPC dialogue: speaker tag, text lines, and the story flag set on close. The web dialogue editor and the JSON->C compiler both read this; ids are assigned by sorted filename order (DIALOGUE_ID_FIRST_GAME + index).

id.description: Unique identifier for this dialogue (lowercase, underscores only). Compiles to DIALOGUE_ID_<UPPER>.

speaker.description: Speaker tag drawn above the text (e.g. 'GUARD:'). Max 11 chars (WRAM staging); empty string = no tag.

items.description: One dialogue line. Max 20 chars incl. terminator (WRAM staging); the box renders 18 wide, so longer than 18 warns.

lines.description: Text lines, advanced one at a time with A. Max 8 (MAX_DIALOGUE_LINES).

completion_flag.description: Story flag set when the dialogue closes (STORY_FLAG_ID_* name, LLM-authored only — the editor never shows this field). Absent/null = none.
